thread:
Maria: Quick sync — onboarding status for Aurora-3B (open) and Raven-7B-Quant. Need: (1) licensing signoff, (2) perf baseline + quant profile, (3) owners for rollout. Target: EOD Wed for legal + perf unless blockers. Ping me if any blocker.

Ashley: I'm on legal queue. Can you paste the license link? @legal-bot?

legal-bot: License check: Raven-7B-Quant includes mixed-license weights; legal review requested. Next step: submit SPDX + modelcard link.

Sonia: I'm owner for Aurora infra integration. Will run perf baseline tomorrow AM. What's the input sequence length we should use?

Tony: For perf, use seq=512, batch sizes [1,4,8] and the quantized fp16/4bit profiles. I'll set up bench and push results to gist. Example run: ```./bench --model aurora-3b --seq 512 --batch 4```

Akash: I'll own rollout gating and can do canary on dedicated pool. Need eng-infra to reserve 2x T4s for smoke.

luis (eng-infra): We have 2 T4s free Thu-Fri. For canary, we'll need container image from eng-runtime with KV cache enabled. @Simon (eng-runtime) can you publish image tag?

Simon (eng-runtime): will cut image tag `aurora-3b/onboard-2026-03-18` tonight. Also enabling `kv_cache=true` and `continuous_batching=opt`. Example config:
```json
{"model":"aurora-3b","kv_cache":true,"batching":"continuous"}
```

Ivy (ML Eng): On perf metrics — please include p95 latency and tokens/sec, also capture memory peak. We want to compare quant vs fp16.

Maria: Adding checklist: license link, modelcard, perf gist link, runtime image tag, infra allocation, ownership matrix. I'm updating the onboard doc.

Ashley: License note — Raven has third-party dataset clause flagged, legal needs modelcard + training dataset manifest.

Maria: Ack. @Ashley can you set expected signoff by Tue EOD? If not, we'll delay.

Ashley: aiming Tue EOD. If I need more info I'll @Maria.

Tony: I'll post perf results to https://redwood.work/gists/aurora-bench tomorrow and tag this thread.

luis (eng-infra): Small note: Dedicated pool auto-scaler might interfere with canary; set min_replicas=2 for the group.

Akash: noted. I'll set rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up in doc and ping the owners tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
